sources.title: ГОСТ 31592-2012 — Редукторы общемашиностроительного применения. Общие технические условия
sources.scope_warning: General-purpose reducer standard; special-purpose crane applicability and actual values require exact equipment/standard documentation.

sources.title: ГОСТ Р 50895-2025 — Муфты зубчатые. Технические условия
sources.scope_warning: Applies to gear couplings within its stated scope; do not transfer requirements or displacement limits to other coupling families.

sources.title: ISO 6336-1:2019 — Calculation of load capacity of spur and helical gears — Part 1
sources.scope_warning: Formal experienced-gear-designer method; does not assure performance of the assembled drive system and is not a beginner design shortcut.

sources.title: ISO 10825-1:2022 — Gears — Wear and damage to gear teeth — Part 1: Nomenclature and characteristics
sources.scope_warning: Condition terminology does not itself provide complete cause, prevention, acceptance or serviceability decisions.

sources.title: ISO 12925-1:2024 — Lubricants ... Family C (gears) — Part 1: Specifications for lubricants for enclosed gear systems
sources.scope_warning: Does not select the actual lubricant for a particular crane reducer without equipment/OEM requirements.

sources.title: ISO 14691:2008 — Flexible couplings for mechanical power transmission — General-purpose applications
sources.scope_warning: Petroleum/petrochemical/natural-gas industry scope. Development companion only; not crane-specific selection/alignment/acceptance authority.

sources.title: ФНП ПС №461 — Правила безопасности ОПО, на которых используются подъемные сооружения
Passport / OEM / drawings / operating documentation for the actual crane drive, reducer and coupling

watchlist.reason: Current and authoritative inside its own petroleum-industry scope, but retained only as a mechanism/terminology companion; prefer a directly applicable crane/general-machinery source for any future normative coupling claim.
